description: This file contains a test script for verifying the behavior of merging symbolic links in a Git repository when the 'core.symlinks' configuration is set to false. It sets up various repository states, performs merge operations, and checks that the results are files, ensuring proper handling of symlinks during merges.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, executing the provided commands.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if the specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes commands expecting them to fail.
